name: Professional, Business & Financial Services
blurb: A central enabling sector for every other part of the economy, with gaps at Levels 3-5 in leadership, compliance and confident use of data.

name: Advanced Manufacturing and Clean Energy
blurb: Automation, robotics and the clean energy transition are reshaping shopfloor work, but moving from operative to technician is the region's biggest bottleneck.

name: Construction and the Built Environment
blurb: Major housing, regeneration and retrofit programmes need more electricians, site supervisors and low-carbon building skills, especially for the region's older housing stock.

name: Health, Life Science & Care
blurb: Europe's largest biomanufacturing cluster sits beside a huge NHS and care system, both needing laboratory, digital health and clearer progression into senior roles.

name: Visitor Economy
blurb: Over 50,000 jobs in hospitality, culture and events need stronger leadership and customer experience skills to fix high staff turnover.

name: Creative Industries
blurb: Growing faster than the national average around the Baltic Triangle, the sector needs people who can fuse creative craft with digital production and business skills.
